description: qlaudified hooks. One shell-form line per hook: py -3 if present, else python3 (docs/design.md, Hook command). MessageDisplay is added in Sprint 2.

hooks.command: command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec py -3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" SessionStart || exec python3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" SessionStart
command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec py -3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" PostToolUse || exec python3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" PostToolUse
command -v py >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec py -3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" Stop || exec python3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.py" Stop
